description: Synthetic sign profile for the generated 18-frame sign-opened clip testdata/synthetic/replay/sign-opened-001 (docs/spec/11 'Fixture origins', gap audit G8; ADR-0037). One invented signboard with one invented sentence; the four distractors are invented dialogue lines that never appear on screen, so ranking the sign's reading against them is a real decision rather than a lookup. No real game text (AGENTS.md rule 5). The sign line's class is the profile's: the pipeline's sign-region hint ranks its reads against this message, and the session's narrated-class veto reads the class off it when narrated_kinds admits signs.

messages.original_text: The tide turns at the second bell.
Someone left a lantern by the gate.
The ferryman does not cross after dark.
Ask the keeper about the old bridge.
